text: {"rulings": [{"id": "1", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "The database being Postgres and its schema being settled are both true at once; one names the engine, the other the stability of its tables."}, {"id": "2", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "Using Postgres full-text search for search says nothing about whether the schema is still changing; both hold together."}, {"id": "3", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "Keeping customs docs in object storage is a storage decision that stands alongside a settled database schema."}, {"id": "4", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "A judgment that full-text search is good enough at current volume does not conflict with the schema being settled."}, {"id": "5", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "The shipment data model (manifest, route, customs docs) remains true when the schema is declared settled; if anything the new claim fixes it in place rather than changing it."}]}
